verdicts.tldr: both negative screenshot assertions hold on an empty Shots slice, so neither pins the gnoweb guard they read as protecting
verdicts.details: TestCommentRealms (plan_test.go:186) and TestCommentBeforeAfter (plan_test.go:234) each build a Plan with Gnoweb false and no Shots field, so shotGrid returns "" at comment.go:131 (len(shots)==0) whatever Comment does above it. Deleting the whole `if p.Gnoweb {` block head and its brace at comment.go:47 and :54 makes the gnoweb sentence and shotGrid unconditional in the default arm, and `go test ./... -run TestComment` stays green. Coverage at head shows the arm is never entered by any test. Adding one Shot to each fixture keeps both green at head and turns both red under that mutation.
verdicts.evidence: head coverage: comment.go:47.15,49.18 2 0 and comment.go:52.4,53.42 2 0. Mutation (comment.go:47 and :54 deleted), PR tests unchanged: `go test ./... -run TestComment` -> ok github.com/gnolang/gno/misc/gnopreview 0.002s. Same mutation with `Shots: []Shot{{File: "_shots/home.png", Label: "Home \u2014 rendered markdown"}}` added to both fixtures: --- FAIL: TestCommentRealms, --- FAIL: TestCommentBeforeAfter (and the finder's --- FAIL: TestVacuousRealmOnlyCommentDropsShots, --- FAIL: TestVacuousBeforeAfterDropsGnowebSample). comment.go restored, fixtures kept: ok ... 0.004s.
verdicts.verify_by: cd misc/gnopreview && go test ./... (green), then remove the `if p.Gnoweb` guard around shotGrid in comment.go's default branch and re-run `go test ./... -run TestComment`: still green. Copy tests/b10-refactor-vacuous-shot-assertions_test.go into misc/gnopreview and re-run under the same mutation: red.

verdicts.tldr: cmp.Or and one mustContain helper fold the default and three copies of the contains loop, 278 lines to 273
verdicts.details: The 4-line `limit := tc.maxRealms; if limit == 0 { limit = defaultMaxRealms }` at plan_test.go:132-135 becomes `cmp.Or(tc.maxRealms, defaultMaxRealms)` inline at the single BuildPlan call. The same six-line for/Contains/Errorf skeleton appears verbatim at plan_test.go:195, :223 and :245 and becomes one `mustContain(t, got, want ...string)` with t.Helper(), so a failure reports the calling test's line. The altitude half holds too: plan.go:192 documents 0 as no cap and main.go:73 exposes `-max-realms ... 0 for no cap`, and because the table uses 0 as the default sentinel no case can reach plan.go:256's uncapped path.
verdicts.evidence: Rewrite applied at head: gofmt -l . empty, go vet ./... silent, go test ./... -> ok github.com/gnolang/gno/misc/gnopreview 0.005s, wc -l plan_test.go 273 (278 before). Patch saved as the artifact.
verdicts.verify_by: apply both rewrites, then cd misc/gnopreview && gofmt -l . && go vet ./... && go test ./... && wc -l plan_test.go

verdicts.tldr: 101 of plan_test.go's 278 lines cover comment.go, which has no test file of its own
verdicts.details: plan_test.go:178-278 is exactly 101 lines and holds TestCommentEmptyIsSilent, TestCommentRealms, TestCommentGnowebHasShots, TestCommentBeforeAfter and TestCommentNoBaseMakesNoClaim; every function they exercise (Comment, pairGrid, shotGrid, tabs, isSeed) is defined in comment.go. The package's five sources are comment.go, crawl.go, main.go, plan.go and shots.go, and the only matching test file is crawl_test.go, so the pairing convention is half-set rather than established: main.go and shots.go have no test file either. The cost is that a reader looking for the comment renderer's coverage finds no comment_test.go, which is how the vacuous assertions in candidate 133 got past round 1. The move costs a file rename and no behaviour.
verdicts.evidence: ls misc/gnopreview/*.go: comment.go crawl.go crawl_test.go main.go plan.go plan_test.go shots.go — no comment_test.go. grep '^func Test' plan_test.go puts the five Comment* tests at :178, :186, :215, :234, :262; comment.go defines Comment:17, pairGrid:99, shotGrid:130, tabs:149, isSeed:157.
verdicts.verify_by: ls misc/gnopreview/*_test.go (crawl_test.go, plan_test.go; no comment_test.go); sed -n '178,278p' misc/gnopreview/plan_test.go names only comment.go symbols
